name: Aife
source:
A female knight under Morrigan's command. She may look petite, but she has the strength that Morrigan trusts in her. She respects Morrigan as a queen.

She is able to fight even with Cú Chulainn, who is famous for his monstrous strength.

She is also a man-hater because of her forbidden feelings of homosexuality. On Morrigan's orders, she heads to the city of Evan to capture Cú Chulainn, but...

[From [url=http://www.masterup.net/hina-soft/kuro_hina/morigan/index.html]official site[/url]]
